decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Hours of UseThe use hereby permitted for restaurant (A3) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times:11.00 - 23.00hours Monday - Sunday, Public and Bank HolidaysAll customers shall have vacated the premises within 30 minutes of the above closing times.

Condition : 4 - Waste and Recycled Materials Storage (Details)The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until detail of the arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - Ventilation Equipment - DetailsThe use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - Ventilation Equipment - Implementation The scheme of ventilation approved under Condition 5 shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.

Condition : 7 - Kitchen Extraction SystemThe kitchen extract system should comprise a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-and carbon filter and ozone injection unit (as described in the Kitchen Ventilation report, dated 18 August 2009 and received 9 September 2009) where:a.	A cowl should be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted; andb.	The system should be serviced not less frequently than annually.

Condition : 8 - Noise	The kitchen extraction system installed should not cause an increase in background noise level (BNL) in the vicinity. When the system is operating at maximum, the noise level should be 10dB(A) lower than the BNL.
Condition : 9 - Sound InsulationThe ceiling/floor separation should comply with the minimum construction/insulation standards set out in the building regulations.

Condition : 10 - The access doorway to the premises at 399 Chiswick High Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use from A1 to A3
